# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## Healthcare Professionals

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

[Healthcare Professionals][9]
* [ Primary Care ][10]
  
  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening
* [ Hospital Care ][11]
  
  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows
* [ Surgical Care ][12]
  
  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]
  
  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and
  at home
* [ Respiratory Health ][14]

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

###### Our Mission

## We strive to make lung cancer a survivable disease.

Partnering with the most innovative minds from the world’s premier oncology research institutions,
we provide funds, staff, and a team of experts to assist in launching and managing
investigator-initiated trials. 

As a 501c(3) nonprofit organization, we’re dedicated to forwarding research that can lead to new
therapeutics, diagnostics, and a better understanding of lung cancer risk factors and resistance
mechanisms.

## The ALCMI Approach to Lung Cancer Science

To maximize our impact and investment, we concentrate our research efforts on 5 areas of focus.
* [Young Lung Cancer]
  Young Lung Cancer
  
  We’re committed to investigating genomic markers in people under 40.
* [Inheritable Disease]
  Inheritable Disease
  
  We seek to understand hereditary risk factors for lung cancer.
* [Resistance Mechanisms]
  Resistance Mechanisms
  
  We conduct resistance mechanism biomarker trials across oncogene populations.
* [Collaboration]
  Collaboration
  
  We work with numerous commercial sponsors and patient advocacy groups.
* [Specimen Research]
  Specimen Research
  
  We maintain a biospecimen bank with more than 2,000 specimens available for study

## *** Now Enrolling ***

Help us learn more about inherited risk in lung cancer. 

Our current study, INHERIT (Investigating Hereditary Risk in Thoracic Cancers), aims to understand
better the genetic risk for developing lung cancer. Partnering with Dana-Farber Cancer Institute and
GO2 for Lung Cancer, we're investigating why lung cancer sometimes runs in families. We're looking
at genetics as well as environmental factors and how these may interact. We hope this information
will ultimately improve lung cancer screening, prevention, and treatment. 

This is just one of the ways we're working to make lung cancer a survivable disease.

# Welcome to Beijing South Region Oncology Hospital

### Caring, curing and relieving for each patient

As a dazzling star memeber founded in 2012 in Asia-Pacific Medical Group, Beijing South Region
Oncology Hospital is an oncology specialist hospital that integrates tumor screening, diagnosis and
treatment, relying on a team of well-known tumor experts from Beijing Cancer Hospital and other
Third-class Grade A hospitals with a high reputation.

Our hospital has more than 20 medical technological departments, such as Department of Oncology,
Oncology surgery, Oncology and Gynecology, TCM Oncology, Radiotherapy, Anesthesiology, Pharmacy,
Radiology, Laboratory, Pathology, Ultrasound, Endoscope, Cardiopulmonary function examination Room.

  problems for cancer patients everywhere.

  ground across diseases with high unmet need.
  
  Learn more about Hematology ][71]

  We’re dedicated to championing the needs and experiences of people living with neurological and

  Learn more about neuroscience ][72]

**쿠키 설정 안내**

저희 웹사이트를 방문하시면, 이용자의 브라우저에 쿠키를 저장하여 정보를 수집합니다. 수집되는 정보는
귀하 또는 귀하의 기기, 선호도와 관련될 수 있으며, 주로 웹사이트를 정상적으로 작동시키고, 더 개인화된
웹 경험을 제공하기 위해 사용됩니다.

다만, 사용자는 일부 유형의 쿠키 사용을 허용하지 않을 수 있으며, 이는 사이트 이용 경험과 제공 가능한
서비스에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다. 쿠키 카테고리별로 자세히 알아보고 기본 설정을 변경하시려면 각
항목을 클릭해 주세요.

참고로, **필수 쿠키**(Strictly Necessary Cookies)는 웹사이트의 정상 작동을 위해 반드시 필요하므로
사용자가 거부할 수 없습니다. (예: 로그인 유지, 설정 기억 등)

보다 자세한 쿠키 정보는 [여기(개인정보처리방침)][74]를 참고하시기 바랍니다.

**동의 설정 관리**
+필수 쿠키 **항상 활성화됨**
이 쿠키는 웹사이트가 정상적으로 작동하는 데 필요하며 시스템에서 꺼질 수 없습니다. 주로 사용자가
요청한 서비스(개인정보 설정, 로그인, 양식 작성 등)를 제공하기 위해 설정됩니다. 브라우저에서 이
쿠키를 차단하거나 알림을 받을 수 있도록 설정할 수 있지만, 이 경우 사이트 일부 기능이 정상적으로
작동하지 않을 수 있습니다. 이 쿠키는 개인 식별 정보를 저장하지 않습니다.
+타겟팅 쿠키
이 쿠키는 광고 파트너를 통해 설정되며, 귀하의 관심사에 기반한 광고를 다른 사이트에 표시하는 데
사용됩니다. 이 쿠키는 직접적으로 개인정보를 저장하지 않으며, 브라우저와 인터넷 기기 식별을 기반으로
작동합니다. 이 쿠키를 허용하지 않으면 타겟팅 광고를 덜 경험하게 됩니다.
+성능 쿠키
이 쿠키는 웹사이트 방문자 수 및 트래픽 소스를 집계하여, 사이트의 성능을 측정하고 개선하는 데
사용됩니다. 어떤 페이지가 인기가 많은지, 방문자가 사이트를 어떻게 이동하는지를 파악하는 데 도움이
됩니다. 모든 정보는 익명으로 수집되며, 이 쿠키를 허용하지 않을 경우 방문 및 활동 기록을 알 수 없어
사이트 성능 모니터링에 제약이 생깁니다.

당사는 또한 귀하의 사이트 이용 정보를 소셜 미디어, 광고 및 분석 파트너와 공유할 수 있습니다.

**쿠키 설정 안내**

저희 웹사이트를 방문하시면, 이용자의 브라우저에 쿠키를 저장하여 정보를 수집합니다. 수집되는 정보는
귀하 또는 귀하의 기기, 선호도와 관련될 수 있으며, 주로 웹사이트를 정상적으로 작동시키고, 더 개인화된
웹 경험을 제공하기 위해 사용됩니다.

다만, 사용자는 일부 유형의 쿠키 사용을 허용하지 않을 수 있으며, 이는 사이트 이용 경험과 제공 가능한
서비스에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다. 쿠키 카테고리별로 자세히 알아보고 기본 설정을 변경하시려면 각
항목을 클릭해 주세요.

참고로, **필수 쿠키**(Strictly Necessary Cookies)는 웹사이트의 정상 작동을 위해 반드시 필요하므로
사용자가 거부할 수 없습니다. (예: 로그인 유지, 설정 기억 등)

보다 자세한 쿠키 정보는 [여기(개인정보처리방침)][74]를 참고하시기 바랍니다.

**동의 설정 관리**
+필수 쿠키 **항상 활성화됨**
이 쿠키는 웹사이트가 정상적으로 작동하는 데 필요하며 시스템에서 꺼질 수 없습니다. 주로 사용자가
요청한 서비스(개인정보 설정, 로그인, 양식 작성 등)를 제공하기 위해 설정됩니다. 브라우저에서 이
쿠키를 차단하거나 알림을 받을 수 있도록 설정할 수 있지만, 이 경우 사이트 일부 기능이 정상적으로
작동하지 않을 수 있습니다. 이 쿠키는 개인 식별 정보를 저장하지 않습니다.
+타겟팅 쿠키
이 쿠키는 광고 파트너를 통해 설정되며, 귀하의 관심사에 기반한 광고를 다른 사이트에 표시하는 데
사용됩니다. 이 쿠키는 직접적으로 개인정보를 저장하지 않으며, 브라우저와 인터넷 기기 식별을 기반으로
작동합니다. 이 쿠키를 허용하지 않으면 타겟팅 광고를 덜 경험하게 됩니다.
+성능 쿠키
이 쿠키는 웹사이트 방문자 수 및 트래픽 소스를 집계하여, 사이트의 성능을 측정하고 개선하는 데
사용됩니다. 어떤 페이지가 인기가 많은지, 방문자가 사이트를 어떻게 이동하는지를 파악하는 데 도움이
됩니다. 모든 정보는 익명으로 수집되며, 이 쿠키를 허용하지 않을 경우 방문 및 활동 기록을 알 수 없어
사이트 성능 모니터링에 제약이 생깁니다.

**쿠키 설정 안내**

저희 웹사이트를 방문하시면, 이용자의 브라우저에 쿠키를 저장하여 정보를 수집합니다. 수집되는 정보는
귀하 또는 귀하의 기기, 선호도와 관련될 수 있으며, 주로 웹사이트를 정상적으로 작동시키고, 더 개인화된
웹 경험을 제공하기 위해 사용됩니다.

다만, 사용자는 일부 유형의 쿠키 사용을 허용하지 않을 수 있으며, 이는 사이트 이용 경험과 제공 가능한
서비스에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다. 쿠키 카테고리별로 자세히 알아보고 기본 설정을 변경하시려면 각
항목을 클릭해 주세요.

참고로, **필수 쿠키**(Strictly Necessary Cookies)는 웹사이트의 정상 작동을 위해 반드시 필요하므로
사용자가 거부할 수 없습니다. (예: 로그인 유지, 설정 기억 등)

보다 자세한 쿠키 정보는 [여기(개인정보처리방침)][74]를 참고하시기 바랍니다.

**동의 설정 관리**
+필수 쿠키 **항상 활성화됨**
이 쿠키는 웹사이트가 정상적으로 작동하는 데 필요하며 시스템에서 꺼질 수 없습니다. 주로 사용자가
요청한 서비스(개인정보 설정, 로그인, 양식 작성 등)를 제공하기 위해 설정됩니다. 브라우저에서 이
쿠키를 차단하거나 알림을 받을 수 있도록 설정할 수 있지만, 이 경우 사이트 일부 기능이 정상적으로
작동하지 않을 수 있습니다. 이 쿠키는 개인 식별 정보를 저장하지 않습니다.
+타겟팅 쿠키
이 쿠키는 광고 파트너를 통해 설정되며, 귀하의 관심사에 기반한 광고를 다른 사이트에 표시하는 데
사용됩니다. 이 쿠키는 직접적으로 개인정보를 저장하지 않으며, 브라우저와 인터넷 기기 식별을 기반으로
작동합니다. 이 쿠키를 허용하지 않으면 타겟팅 광고를 덜 경험하게 됩니다.
+성능 쿠키
이 쿠키는 웹사이트 방문자 수 및 트래픽 소스를 집계하여, 사이트의 성능을 측정하고 개선하는 데
사용됩니다. 어떤 페이지가 인기가 많은지, 방문자가 사이트를 어떻게 이동하는지를 파악하는 데 도움이
됩니다. 모든 정보는 익명으로 수집되며, 이 쿠키를 허용하지 않을 경우 방문 및 활동 기록을 알 수 없어
사이트 성능 모니터링에 제약이 생깁니다.

## The International Association for the Study of Lung Cancer

The IASLC is a global multidisciplinary organization dedicated to eradication of all forms of lung
cancer. From provision of educational events around the world and virtually to research projects and
publications that advance the science of lung cancer, the IASLC's members—consisting of medical,
surgical, and radiation oncologists, as well as other thoracic oncology specialists such as nurses,
basic scientists, pathologists, radiologists, pulmonologists, statisticians, patient research
advocates, patients, and their caregivers—are raising the bar for care of patients with lung cancer.

## The International Association for the Study of Lung Cancer

The IASLC is a global multidisciplinary organization dedicated to eradication of all forms of lung
cancer. From provision of educational events around the world and virtually to research projects and
publications that advance the science of lung cancer, the IASLC's members—consisting of medical,
surgical, and radiation oncologists, as well as other thoracic oncology specialists such as nurses,
basic scientists, pathologists, radiologists, pulmonologists, statisticians, patient research
advocates, patients, and their caregivers—are raising the bar for care of patients with lung cancer.

IMFINZI and IMJUDO are medicines that may treat certain cancers by working with your immune system.

your body and can affect the way they work. These problems can sometimes become severe or
life-threatening and can lead to death. You can have more than one of these problems at the same
time. These problems may happen anytime during treatment or even after your treatment has ended.

IMFINZI and IMJUDO are medicines that may treat certain cancers by working with your immune system.

life-threatening and can lead to death. You can have more than one of these problems at the same

## What are IMFINZI and IMJUDO?

IMFINZI and IMJUDO are prescription medications that may treat certain cancers.

IMFINZI is used to treat adults with a type of lung cancer called NSCLC.
* IMFINZI may be used alone when your NSCLC has not spread outside your chest, cannot be removed by
  surgery, and has responded or stabilized with initial treatment with chemotherapy that contains
  platinum, given at the same time as radiation therapy.
* IMFINZI may be used in combination with chemotherapy that contains platinum prior to surgery and
  alone after surgery when your NSCLC is able to be removed by surgery, and your tumor does not have
  an abnormal “EGFR” or “ALK” gene.
* IMFINZI may be used in combination with IMJUDO and chemotherapy that contains platinum when your
  NSCLC has spread to other parts of your body (metastatic) and your tumor does not have an abnormal
  “EGFR” or “ALK” gene.

IMFINZI is used to treat adults with a type of lung cancer called SCLC.
* IMFINZI may be used alone when your LS-SCLC cannot be removed by surgery and has responded or
  stabilized after initial treatment with chemotherapy that contains platinum, given at the same
  time as radiation therapy.
* IMFINZI may be used with the chemotherapy medicines etoposide and either carboplatin or cisplatin
  as your first treatment when your SCLC has spread within your lungs or to other parts of the body
  (extensive-stage small cell lung cancer, or ES-SCLC).

IMFINZI is used in combination with chemotherapy medicines gemcitabine and cisplatin to treat adults
with a type of cancer called BTC, including cancer of the bile ducts (cholangiocarcinoma) and
gallbladder cancer, when your BTC has spread to nearby tissues (locally advanced), or has spread to
other parts of the body (metastatic).

IMFINZI is used in combination with IMJUDO to treat adults with a type of liver cancer that cannot
be removed by surgery (unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma or uHCC).

IMFINZI is used in combination with the chemotherapy medicines carboplatin and paclitaxel followed
by IMFINZI alone to treat adults with a type of uterine cancer called endometrial cancer that has
spread (advanced) or has come back (recurred), and a laboratory test shows that your tumor is
mismatch repair deficient (dMMR).

IMFINZI is used in combination with Bacillus Calmette-Guérin (BCG) to treat a type of bladder cancer
called high-risk non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC) that has not spread into the muscle
layer of the bladder, when you have not had prior treatment with BCG.

IMFINZI may be used in combination with the chemotherapy medicines gemcitabine and cisplatin
(neoadjuvant treatment) prior to surgical removal of your bladder followed by IMFINZI alone after
surgery (adjuvant treatment) to treat a type of bladder cancer called muscle- invasive bladder
cancer (MIBC) that has spread into the muscle layer of the bladder but not to other parts of the

## What are IMFINZI and IMJUDO?

IMFINZI and IMJUDO are prescription medications that may treat certain cancers.

IMFINZI is used to treat adults with a type of lung cancer called NSCLC.
* IMFINZI may be used alone when your NSCLC has not spread outside your chest, cannot be removed by

  platinum, given at the same time as radiation therapy.

IMFINZI is used to treat adults with a type of lung cancer called SCLC.
* IMFINZI may be used alone when your LS-SCLC cannot be removed by surgery and has responded or
  stabilized after initial treatment with chemotherapy that contains platinum, given at the same

be removed by surgery (unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma or uHCC).

IMFINZI is used in combination with the chemotherapy medicines carboplatin and paclitaxel followed
by IMFINZI alone to treat adults with a type of uterine cancer called endometrial cancer that has
spread (advanced) or has come back (recurred), and a laboratory test shows that your tumor is
mismatch repair deficient (dMMR).

called high-risk non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC) that has not spread into the muscle
layer of the bladder, when you have not had prior treatment with BCG.

(neoadjuvant treatment) prior to surgical removal of your bladder followed by IMFINZI alone after

cancer (MIBC) that has spread into the muscle layer of the bladder but not to other parts of the
body.

## Ask your doctor about KEYTRUDA QLEX, an FDA-approved injectable immunotherapy

Given just under the skin as a subcutaneous injection by your healthcare provider in the stomach
area or thigh, KEYTRUDA QLEX can be administered in as little as 1 minute* every 3 weeks or 2
minutes* every 6 weeks. Your dosing schedule depends on the treatment plan your doctor prescribes.

*Injection time only. Not total appointment time.

[Get to know KEYTRUDA QLEX][37]

See Indications

KEYTRUDA and KEYTRUDA QLEX are prescription medicines used to treat:
* a kind of lung cancer called [ non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC)][38].
  * Each may be used in combination with chemotherapy that contains platinum and another
    chemotherapy medicine before surgery when you have early-stage NSCLC, which can be removed by
    surgery, **and** then continued alone after surgery to help prevent your lung cancer from coming
    back.
  * Each may be used with the chemotherapy medicines pemetrexed and a platinum as your first
    treatment when your lung cancer has spread ([advanced NSCLC][39]) **and** is a type called
    “[nonsquamous][40]” **and** your tumor does not have an abnormal “EGFR” or “ALK” gene.
  * Each may be used with the chemotherapy medicines carboplatin and either paclitaxel or paclitaxel
    protein-bound as your first treatment when your lung cancer has spread ([advanced NSCLC][41])
    **and** is a type called “[squamous][42].”
  * Each may be used alone as your first treatment when your lung cancer has not spread outside your
    chest (stage III) and you cannot have surgery or chemotherapy with radiation, **or** your NSCLC
    has spread to other areas of your body ([advanced NSCLC][43]), **and** your tumor tests positive
    for “PD‑L1” **and** does not have an abnormal “EGFR” or “ALK” gene.
  * Each may also be used alone for [advanced NSCLC][44] if you have tried chemotherapy that
    contains platinum and it did not work or is no longer working **and**, your tumor tests positive
    for “PD-L1” **and** if your tumor has an abnormal “EGFR” or “ALK” gene, you have also received
    an “EGFR” or “ALK” inhibitor medicine that did not work or is no longer working.

## How KRAS Kickers Helps 

# KRAS Kickers is a patient led cancer nonprofit organization  translating KRAS cancer research into
# clear patient education, insights, for advocacy and survivorship support.
# 
# Founded by a KRAS G12D cancer patient who wanted to understand what that means without a PhD.
# 
# KRAS appears in about 1 in 4 adult cancers, including many lung, pancreatic, appendix, colon, and
# rare cancers. The variant matters!  More than just an alphabet G12A, G12C, G12D, G12V, Q61, G13
# each one matters possibly impacting your treatment strategy opportunities now or next.
# 
# KRAS Kickers shares research, tracks updates across cancers, and builds community.
# 
# Turning jargon into informed choices across all KRAS mutated, cancers with clear updates, expert
# voices, and community.

# KRAS Kickers is a patient led cancer nonprofit organization  translating KRAS cancer research into
# clear patient education, insights, for advocacy and survivorship support.
# 
# Founded by a KRAS G12D cancer patient who wanted to understand what that means without a PhD.
# 
# KRAS appears in about 1 in 4 adult cancers, including many lung, pancreatic, appendix, colon, and
# rare cancers. The variant matters!  More than just an alphabet G12A, G12C, G12D, G12V, Q61, G13
# each one matters possibly impacting your treatment strategy opportunities now or next.
# 
# KRAS Kickers shares research, tracks updates across cancers, and builds community.
# 
# Turning jargon into informed choices across all KRAS mutated, cancers with clear updates, expert

# Improving Lung Cancer Care in Australia

Improving Lung Cancer Care in AustraliaImproving Lung Cancer Care in AustraliaImproving Lung Cancer

**A nationwide collaboration**

## Lung cancer is the leading cause of cancer death in Australia and has the lowest survival rate.

Lung cancer accounts for 9% of all cancers but is responsible for 18% of deaths from all cancers in
Australia. The number of years of potential life lost each year to lung cancer in Australia is
estimated to be similar to that of colorectal and breast cancer *combined. *

Despite advances in treatments and evidence-based guidelines to inform best clinical practice, the
five year survival for all lung cancer in Australia remains terribly low at only 19%.  

## LUCAP drives change to improve standards of lung cancer care

#### What is LUCAP?

#### What is LUCAP?

#### What is LUCAP?

LUCAP is a patient-focused research group who are developing a national clinical quality data
platform for lung cancer that collects, analyses and reports on information like how quickly people
get lung cancer tests, what sort of tests are done and how quickly people get treatments. 

LUCAP researchers can compare this information against A

Show More

LUCAP is a patient-focused research group who are developing a national clinical quality data
platform for lung cancer that collects, analyses and reports on information like how quickly people
get lung cancer tests, what sort of tests are done and how quickly people get treatments. 

LUCAP researchers can compare this information against Australian and international guidelines for
best clinical care and treatments, so we can compare standards of care between hospitals. If it
looks like something is not going well in one hospital, LUCAP can help the hospital to learn what
they need to do differently to improve care, or if something is going very well, LUCAP will help
other hospitals learn from the success. This will support lung patients to receive the best quality
of care. 

[The LUCAP team][28] is made up of experts in lung cancer care, research and advocacy including:
respiratory physicians, thoracic surgeons, medical oncologists, radiation oncologists, nurses, and
importantly, lung cancer patients and survivors. 

LUCAP has the full support of the Lung Foundation Australia, the Institute for Respiratory Health
and other peak health bodies. Find out more about our project partners [here][29].

#### What is LUCAP?

#### What is LUCAP?

Our mission is to improve the safety, quality and outcomes of health care for all lung cancer
patients in Australia.  

#### Our Vision

#### What is LUCAP?

#### Our Vision

A national data platform that enables the performance of lung cancer service providers to be
compared against a set of national standards and supports innovative research in lung cancer care
and treatments.

LUCAP is a patient-focused research group who are developing a national clinical quality data
platform for lung cancer that collects, analyses and reports on information like how quickly people
get lung cancer tests, what sort of tests are done and how quickly people get treatments. 

LUCAP researchers can compare this information against Australian and international guidelines for
best clinical care and treatments, so we can compare standards of care between hospitals. If it
looks like something is not going well in one hospital, LUCAP can help the hospital to learn what
they need to do differently to improve care, or if something is going very well, LUCAP will help
other hospitals learn from the success. This will support lung patients to receive the best quality
of care.

respiratory physicians, thoracic surgeons, medical oncologists, radiation oncologists, nurses, and

lung cancer every year.

[Learn About Lung Cancer][151]

Resources

## Access Lung Cancer Resources

A lung cancer diagnosis might be overwhelming at first — but we can help. Our caring patient
advocates, nurses, and attorneys will do everything they can to help you get support, justice, and
helpful resources.

### High-Risk Occupations

Our team has compiled a list of jobs and worksites that put workers at a greater risk of asbestos
lung cancer. View the list and pursue justice.

[High-Risk Asbestos Jobs][152]

### Lung Cancer Resources

We’ve gathered top lung cancer resources to help you and your family get the support you need after
a diagnosis. View our lung cancer resources now.

[Lung Cancer Resources][153]
Treatment

## Treating Lung Cancer

Treatments for asbestos lung cancer include chemotherapy, radiation, surgery, and immunotherapy.
Learn which treatments will be best in your case.

[Lung Cancer Treatment][154]

[An older male walks with the help of a younger female nurse in blue scrubs.][An older male walks
with the help of a younger female nurse in blue scrubs.]
Compensation

## Lung Cancer Compensation

You deserve financial compensation if you developed lung cancer due to asbestos exposure.
Manufacturers of asbestos-based products let you get sick all in the name of profit. We’ll help you
pursue compensation to pay medical bills and any other expenses.

### Get a Free Case Review

Start the process with a free case review. Our patient advocates can help you find top lung cancer
lawyers and law firms.

### File a Lung Cancer Claim

A lung cancer attorney can file a claim on your behalf. This takes the stress of filing the case off
you and your family.

### Receive Compensation

Your partner attorneys will work to get the most amount of financial compensation possible in your
case.

## Access Lung Cancer Resources

A lung cancer diagnosis might be overwhelming at first — but we can help. Our caring patient
advocates, nurses, and attorneys will do everything they can to help you get support, justice, and
helpful resources.

### High-Risk Occupations

Our team has compiled a list of jobs and worksites that put workers at a greater risk of asbestos
lung cancer. View the list and pursue justice.

[High-Risk Asbestos Jobs][152]

### Lung Cancer Resources

We’ve gathered top lung cancer resources to help you and your family get the support you need after
a diagnosis. View our lung cancer resources now.

[Lung Cancer Resources][153]
Treatment

## Treating Lung Cancer

Treatments for asbestos lung cancer include chemotherapy, radiation, surgery, and immunotherapy.
Learn which treatments will be best in your case.

[Lung Cancer Treatment][154]

Compensation

## Lung Cancer Compensation

You deserve financial compensation if you developed lung cancer due to asbestos exposure.
Manufacturers of asbestos-based products let you get sick all in the name of profit. We’ll help you
pursue compensation to pay medical bills and any other expenses.

### Get a Free Case Review

Start the process with a free case review. Our patient advocates can help you find top lung cancer
lawyers and law firms.

### File a Lung Cancer Claim

A lung cancer attorney can file a claim on your behalf. This takes the stress of filing the case off
you and your family.

### Receive Compensation

Your partner attorneys will work to get the most amount of financial compensation possible in your
case.

Screening & Early Detection

Finding lung cancer early on can make a difference. Learn about early detection and all the details
you need to know about the screening process.

[ Learn More ][118]
Biomarker Testing

Not all lung cancers are the same. Comprehensive biomarker testing can identify specific genetic
“drivers” in your cancer (called biomarkers) that cause cancer to grow and spread in different ways.
This can help you identify the appropriate treatment plan for you.

[ Learn More ][119]
What Are Lung Nodules?

Lung nodules are tissue growths that take a round or oval shape. They are fairly common, and most
are non-cancerous.

#### [Learning from the history of nursing][151]

Perhaps the most consistent thread throughout nursing history is the commitment to caring for
individuals during times of illness, injury, suffering, and vulnerability. From informal caregiving
in families and religious communities to modern professional nursing practice, compassion remains
central. Historical examples: nurses serving soldiers during war and early public health nurses
caring for impoverished populations. Contemporary relevance: patient-centered care, compassionate
communication, and holistic health and healing.

## Why NMSC?

##### Accurate market positionings

01

Identify your competitive advantage with our comprehensive and detailed market positioning services.
We work with you to create a customer-centric strategy that will help you succeed in the
marketplace.

##### Market estimates & forecasts

02

Receive accurate estimates and forecasts for your industry with our expert analysis. We offer a
range of services, including opportunity analysis, competitive landscape assessments, and market
position studies.

##### Validation and data assurance checks

03

We have a process in place to run periodic checks on our data models to determine correlations
between macroeconomic datasets and our sourced market data to ensure maximum accuracy.

##### Profound data sources

04

We take our data sources seriously. Our data sources are deep-rooted, reliable, accurate, and
well-regarded, which include paid databases, primary research, statistical organizations, government
agencies, and industry intelligence providers, among others.

##### Industry analysis with clarity

05

Our market taxonomy allows you to work smarter by aligning your revenues with relevant market
metrics. We allow you to step back from tactical tasks of monitoring the markets - so you can
resurface from below the waterline.

##### N.E.X.T. insights

06

For a deeper dive into a niche sector, we present market financial information that is complete,
accurate, and verifiable through what we call N.E.X.T. Insights - so you can trust what you see.

### Fitzwilliam Hospital, 23 July 2026

[star rating]

After an intense training and following hiking I was limping and had pain in my knee. Later I had
tight muscles for about a month and nothing helped me. Even after a short walk I had pain in my legs
and could never get muscles relaxed. I made an appointment with Dr Sally Mirtle, and it was my first
ever appointment with a physiotherapist. During 30 mins Sally carefully listened to me, assessed my
legs, made a conclusion about my joints that I never considered before. Then she did a quick massage
of my legs but surprisingly not where I had pain, and not on that particular leg. How surprised I
was when just after this short massage session I could walk back to the station and my legs were
light and it was no pain. Sally gave me a workout plan and explained every exercise carefully. What
I liked was that she didn't give me many exercises, just a few but very efficient. I had a plan of
my hikes and explained to Sally how it is important for me. Because of Sally's plan I managed to do
these hikes though not 2 full days but still managed to be prepared for them quickly, and what is
the most important, Sally's treatment and workout plan allowed me to be prepared for my first
mountaineering training. I was surprised how Sally could see what the problem was, and she knows the
biomechanics of legs so well that asked me to do stretching that I would never expect in my case,
but it really helped me. I also wanted to note her humanity - Sally really wants to help, has high
empathy and kindness. Many thanks, Vera

my hikes and explained to Sally how it is important for me. Because of Sally's plan I managed to do
these hikes though not 2 full days but still managed to be prepared for them quickly, and what is
the most important, Sally's treatment and workout plan allowed me to be prepared for my first
mountaineering training. I was surprised how Sally could see what the problem was, and she knows the
biomechanics of legs so well that asked me to do stretching that I would never expect in my case,
but it really helped me. I also wanted to note her humanity - Sally really wants to help, has high
empathy and kindness. Many thanks, Vera

# Simoncini Cancer Therapy

Treat cancer as a fungus
[dr tullio simoncini]

#### Dr. Simoncini Cancer Therapy

Dr. Tullio Simoncini, – oncologist from Rome, Italy – has pioneered sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO3)
therapy as a means to treat cancer. The fundamental theory behind this treatment lies in the fact
that, despite a number of variable factors, the formation and spreading of tumors is simply the
result of the presence of a fungus.

[more][7]
[simoncini sodium bicarbonate iv]

#### Sodium Bicarbonate

Sodium bicarbonate, unlike other anti-fungal remedies to which the fungus can become immune, is
extremely diffusible and retains its ability to penetrate the tumor, due to the speed at which the
sodium bicarbonate disintegrates the tumor. This speed makes fungi’s adaptability impossible,
rendering it defenseless.

[more][8]

## General information

[dr tulklio simoncini rome italy]

#### About Dr. Simoncini

Tullio Simoncini is a roman doctor specialising in oncology, diabetology and in metabolic disorders.
He has a strong opposition to any type of intellectual conformity, which is often based on
suppositions without foundation or worse, on lies and falsities.

[sodium bicarbonate IV solution]

#### Sodium bicarbonate

The fundamental reason and the motives that suggest a therapy with sodium bicarbonate against
tumours is that, although with the concurrence of a myriad of variable concausal factors – the
development and the local and remote proliferation of these tumours has a cause that is exclusively
fungin.

[candida albicans]

#### Candida Albicans

Candida in cancer patients is usually interpreted as a consequence of the weakening and of the
exhaustion of the organism because of neoplastic lesions. But candida is not a post hoc but an ante
hoc cause.

[treatment-protocols]

#### Treatment protocols

Dr. Simoncini’s methods have cured people for over 25 years. Many of his patients recovered
completely from cancer, even in cases where official oncology had given up.
The best way to try to eliminate a tumour is to bring it into contact with sodium bicarbonate, as
closely as possible.

# Simoncini Cancer Therapy

Treat cancer as a fungus
[dr tullio simoncini]

#### Dr. Simoncini Cancer Therapy

Dr. Tullio Simoncini, – oncologist from Rome, Italy – has pioneered sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO3)
therapy as a means to treat cancer. The fundamental theory behind this treatment lies in the fact
that, despite a number of variable factors, the formation and spreading of tumors is simply the
result of the presence of a fungus.

[more][7]
[simoncini sodium bicarbonate iv]

#### Sodium Bicarbonate

Sodium bicarbonate, unlike other anti-fungal remedies to which the fungus can become immune, is
extremely diffusible and retains its ability to penetrate the tumor, due to the speed at which the
sodium bicarbonate disintegrates the tumor. This speed makes fungi’s adaptability impossible,
rendering it defenseless.

[more][8]

## General information

[dr tulklio simoncini rome italy]

#### About Dr. Simoncini

Tullio Simoncini is a roman doctor specialising in oncology, diabetology and in metabolic disorders.
He has a strong opposition to any type of intellectual conformity, which is often based on
suppositions without foundation or worse, on lies and falsities.

[sodium bicarbonate IV solution]

#### Sodium bicarbonate

The fundamental reason and the motives that suggest a therapy with sodium bicarbonate against
tumours is that, although with the concurrence of a myriad of variable concausal factors – the
development and the local and remote proliferation of these tumours has a cause that is exclusively
fungin.

[candida albicans]

#### Candida Albicans

Candida in cancer patients is usually interpreted as a consequence of the weakening and of the
exhaustion of the organism because of neoplastic lesions. But candida is not a post hoc but an ante
hoc cause.

[treatment-protocols]

#### Treatment protocols

Dr. Simoncini’s methods have cured people for over 25 years. Many of his patients recovered
completely from cancer, even in cases where official oncology had given up.
The best way to try to eliminate a tumour is to bring it into contact with sodium bicarbonate, as
closely as possible.

## Committed to Optimizing Human Health

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company focused on the discovery,
development, and commercialization of patient-, physician-, caregiver-, and societal‑friendly
medicinal therapies intended to improve quality of life, increase potential duration of life, and
resolve serious unmet medical needs.

Summit Therapeutics’ mission is to resolve serious, unmet medical needs for the betterment of
overall human health. Summit’s leadership is committed to making a significant positive difference
in the quality and potential duration of life for oncology patients facing difficult diagnoses.
Summit has enacted the path to providing patient-, physician-, caregiver‑, and societal‑friendly
therapies while creating opportunities for durable growth as a company by initiating several trials
with its lead candidate, ivonescimab. Ivonescimab is known as SMT112 in Summit’s license
territories: United States, Canada, Europe, Japan, Latin America (including Mexico, Central America,
South America, and the Caribbean), the Middle East, and Africa; and as AK112 in Akeso's license
territories, rest of world. Ivonescimab is known a novel, potential first-in-class investigational
bispecific antibody combining the effects of immunotherapy via a blockade of PD-1 with the
anti-angiogenesis effects associated with blocking VEGF into a single molecule.

Ivonescimab displays cooperative binding with each of its intended targets, with higher affinity in
the presence of both PD‑1 and VEGF. Ivonescimab was developed by Akeso, Inc. (HKEX Code: 9926.HK).
It is currently being studied in several Phase 3 clinical trials in Summit’s license territories, in
addition to multiple Phase 3 clinical trials in China led by Akeso. Summit has begun its clinical
development of ivonescimab in non‑small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). Ivonescimab is an investigational
therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical
Products Administration (NMPA).

Summit intends to expand the opportunity and potential of ivonescimab into additional solid tumors
in the future, based on promising data generated by its partners at Akeso in China. Globally, over
3,000 patients have been treated with ivonescimab across all clinical trials to date. Summit will
continue to invest in its business and pipeline, driven by Team Summit’s unmatched capabilities,
including speed and operational excellence, with the goal of bringing its mission into a reality.

## Committed to Optimizing Human Health

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company focused on the discovery,
development, and commercialization of patient-, physician-, caregiver-, and societal‑friendly
medicinal therapies intended to improve quality of life, increase potential duration of life, and
resolve serious unmet medical needs.

Summit Therapeutics’ mission is to resolve serious, unmet medical needs for the betterment of
overall human health. Summit’s leadership is committed to making a significant positive difference
in the quality and potential duration of life for oncology patients facing difficult diagnoses.
Summit has enacted the path to providing patient-, physician-, caregiver‑, and societal‑friendly
therapies while creating opportunities for durable growth as a company by initiating several trials
with its lead candidate, ivonescimab. Ivonescimab is known as SMT112 in Summit’s license
territories: United States, Canada, Europe, Japan, Latin America (including Mexico, Central America,
South America, and the Caribbean), the Middle East, and Africa; and as AK112 in Akeso's license
territories, rest of world. Ivonescimab is known a novel, potential first-in-class investigational
bispecific antibody combining the effects of immunotherapy via a blockade of PD-1 with the
anti-angiogenesis effects associated with blocking VEGF into a single molecule.

Ivonescimab displays cooperative binding with each of its intended targets, with higher affinity in
the presence of both PD‑1 and VEGF. Ivonescimab was developed by Akeso, Inc. (HKEX Code: 9926.HK).
It is currently being studied in several Phase 3 clinical trials in Summit’s license territories, in
addition to multiple Phase 3 clinical trials in China led by Akeso. Summit has begun its clinical
development of ivonescimab in non‑small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). Ivonescimab is an investigational
therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical
Products Administration (NMPA).

Summit intends to expand the opportunity and potential of ivonescimab into additional solid tumors
in the future, based on promising data generated by its partners at Akeso in China. Globally, over
3,000 patients have been treated with ivonescimab across all clinical trials to date. Summit will
continue to invest in its business and pipeline, driven by Team Summit’s unmatched capabilities,
including speed and operational excellence, with the goal of bringing its mission into a reality.

## IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION

TAGRISSO may cause serious side effects, including:
* Lung problems. TAGRISSO may cause severe lung problems that may lead to death. Symptoms may be
  similar to those symptoms from lung cancer. Tell your healthcare provider right away if you have
  any new or worsening lung symptoms, including trouble breathing, shortness of breath, cough, or
  fever
* Heart prob

TECENTRIQ^{®} (atezolizumab) is an immunotherapy designed to target and treat certain types of
cancer, including PDL1+ [non-small cell lung cancer][30] after surgery and chemo (NSCLC),
[metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (mNSCLC)][31], extensive-stage [small cell lung cancer
(ES-SCLC)][32], [hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC)][33] that has spread or cannot be removed by
surgery, and BRAF V600+ advanced [melanoma][34].

TECENTRIQ is different than traditional chemotherapy. It is a cancer immunotherapy and an anti-PD-L1
antibody, meaning it is designed to block PD-L1. By blocking PD-L1, TECENTRIQ is thought to reveal
cancer cells. This process helps your immune system recognize, target, and attack your cancer.
TECENTRIQ may also affect normal cells.

TECENTRIQ is administered as infusions into a vein through an intravenous (IV) line.

Severe side effects of TECENTRIQ include lung problems, intestinal problems, liver problems, hormone
gland problems, kidney problems, skin problems, problems in other organs, severe infusion reactions,
and complications including graft-versus-host disease (GVHD) in people who have received a bone
marrow (stem cell) transplant that uses donor stem cells (allogeneic).

##### Indications

**What is TECENTRIQ?**

TECENTRIQ is a prescription medicine used to treat:

**Adults with a type of lung cancer called non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).
**
* **TECENTRIQ may be used alone as a treatment for your lung cancer:**
  * to help prevent your lung cancer from coming back after your tumor(s) has been removed by
    surgery and you have received platinum-based chemotherapy, **and**
  * you have stage 2 to stage 3A NSCLC (talk to your healthcare provider about what these stages
    mean), **and**
  * your cancer tests positive for “PD-L1”.
* **TECENTRIQ may be used alone as your first treatment when your lung cancer:**
  * has spread or grown, **and** 
  * your cancer tests positive for “high PD-L1”, **and**
  * your tumor does not have an abnormal “EGFR” or “ALK” gene.
* **TECENTRIQ may be used with the medicines bevacizumab, paclitaxel, and carboplatin as your first
  treatment when your lung cancer:**
  * has spread or grown, **and**
  * is a type called “non-squamous NSCLC”, **and**
  * your tumor does not have an abnormal “EGFR” or “ALK” gene.
* **TECENTRIQ may be used with the medicines paclitaxel protein-bound and carboplatin as your first
  treatment when your lung cancer:**
  * has spread or grown, **and**
  * is a type called “non-squamous NSCLC”, **and**
  * your tumor does not have an abnormal “EGFR” or “ALK” gene.
* **TECENTRIQ may be used alone when your lung cancer:**
  * has spread or grown, **and**
  * you have tried chemotherapy that contains platinum, and it did not work or is no longer working.
